The CBI (Copenhagen Burnout Inventory) is a public-domain questionnaire: Kristensen TS, Borritz M, Villadsen E, Christensen KB. Work & Stress. 2005;19(3):192-207 (the authors’ document). The Spanish version is the one validated by Molinero Ruiz E, Basart Gómez-Quintero H, Moncada Lluis S. Rev Esp Salud Pública. 2013;87(2):165-179 (article, in Spanish). Scores are calculated as the authors do: from 0 to 100, using the mean of the items in each part.

The CBI burnout questionnaire is in the public domain. The Spanish version is the one validated in Spain (2013). The Catalan version is a translation made with the artificial intelligence tool from the Spanish one, without review or validation. The English version is the original text published by the authors, validated with Danish samples.
